function.description: [[Resource location]] of the function to apply. Valid functions are described below.

options.apply_bonus: Applies a predefined bonus formula to the count of the item stack.
options.copy_components: Copies components from a specified source onto an item.
options.copy_custom_data: Copies NBT values from a specified block entity or entity, or from command storage to the item's `minecraft:custom_data` component.
options.copy_name: Copies an entity's or a block entity's name tag into the item's display.Name tag.
options.copy_state: Copies block state properties provided by [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]] to the item's BlockStateTag tag.
options.enchant_randomly: Enchants the item with one randomly-selected enchantment. The power of the enchantment, if applicable, is random. A book will convert to an [[enchanted book]] when enchanted.
options.enchant_with_levels: Enchants the item, with the specified [[Enchantment mechanics#How Enchantments Are Chosen|enchantment level]] (roughly equivalent to using an [[enchantment table]] at that level). A book will convert to an [[enchanted book]].
options.exploration_map: If the origin is provided by  [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]], converts an empty map into an [[explorer map]] leading to a nearby generated structure.
options.explosion_decay: Removes some items from a stack, if the explosion ratius is provided by [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]]. Each item in the item stack has a chance of 1/explosion radius to be lost.
options.fill_player_head: Adds required item tags of a player head.
options.furnace_smelt: Smelts the item as it would be in a furnace without changing its count.
options.limit_count: Limits the count of every item stack.
options.looting_enchant: Adjusts the stack size based on the level of the [[Looting]] enchantment on the {{cd|killer}} entity provided by [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]].
options.set_banner_pattern: Adds or replaces banner patterns of a banner. Function successfully adds patterns into NBT tag even if invoked on a non-banner.
options.set_book_cover: Sets the cover details of the `minecraft:written_book_content` component`. If present, any pages in the book are left untouched.
options.set_contents: Sets the contents of a container block item to a list of entries.
options.set_enchantments: Modifies the item's enchantments. A book will convert to an [[enchanted book]].
options.set_instrument: Sets the item tags for instrument items to a random value from a tag.
options.set_loot_table: Sets the loot table for a container block when placed and opened.
options.set_lore: Adds or changes the item's lore.
options.set_name: Adds or changes the item's custom name.
options.set_potion: Sets the Potion tag of an item.
options.set_stew_effect: Sets the status effects for [[suspicious stew]]. Fails if invoked on an item that is not suspicious stew.
options.set_writable_book_pages: Manipulates the pages of the `minecraft:writable_book_content` component.
options.set_written_book_pages: Manipulates the pages of the `minecraft:writable_book_content` component.

conditions.description: A list of [[predicate]]s, of which all must pass, for this function to be applied.

enchantment.description: [[Java_Edition_data_value#Enchantments|ID of an enchantment]] on the tool provided by [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]] used for level calculation.

formula.description: A [[resource location]]. Can be binomial_with_bonus_count for a binomial distribution (with n=level + extra, p=probability), uniform_bonus_count for uniform distribution (from 0 to level * bonusMultiplier), or ore_drops for a special function used for ore drops in the vanilla game (Count *= (max(1; randomInt(0''(inclusive)'' .. (Level + 2)''(exclusive)''))))

options.ore_drops: for a special function used for ore drops in the vanilla game (Count *= (max(1; randomInt(0''(inclusive)'' .. (Level + 2)''(exclusive)''))))

source.description: Source type to pull from. Specifies an entity or block entity from loot context. Only allowed value is `block_entity`.

include.description: A list of components to include. If omitted, all components are copied.

exclude.description: A list of components to exclude.

options.description: Shorthand form of {{nbt|compound|source}} below with {{nbt|string|type}} set to context. Specifies an entity or block entity from [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]]. Can be {{cd|block_entity}}, {{cd|this}}, {{cd|killer}}, {{cd|direct_killer}}, or {{cd|killer_player}}.
Information of the block entity, entity or storage to copy NBT from.

type.description: Set to context to use a block entity or an entity as the source, or storage to use a command storage as the source.

target.description: Included only if type is set to context. Specifies an entity or block entity from [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]] to copy NBT from. Can be {{cd|block_entity}}, {{cd|this}}, {{cd|killer}}, {{cd|direct_killer}}, or {{cd|killer_player}}.

source.description: Included only if type is set to storage. A [[resource location]] specifying the storage ID to copy NBT from.
The [[NBT path format|NBT path]] to copy from.

target.description: The [[NBT path format|NBT path]] to copy to, starting from the item's tag tag.

op.description: Set to replace to replace any existing contents of the target NBT path, append to append to a list or array, or merge to merge into a compound tag.

options.replace: to replace any existing contents of the target NBT path
options.append: to append to a list or array
options.merge: to merge into a compound tag

source.description: - The target whose name will be copied. Specifies an entity or block entity from [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]]. Can be {{cd|block_entity}}, {{cd|this}}, {{cd|killer}}, or {{cd|killer_player}} (cannot be {{cd|direct_killer}}).

block.description: A [[Resource location|block ID]]. Function fails if the block doesn't match the {{nbt|list|properties}} list.

properties.description: A list of properties to copy.

element.description: The name of a block state to copy.

enchantments.description: Optional. List of [[Java_Edition_data_value#Enchantments|enchantment IDs]] to choose from. If omitted, all discoverable enchantments (currently only [[Soul speed]] and [[Swift Sneak]] are undiscoverable) applicable to the item are possible.

only_compatible.description: Whether only enchantments that are compatible with the item should be chosen (i.e. the item is listed in the enchantments `supported_items`). Books are always considered compatible.

levels.description: Specifies the enchantment level to use.

treasure.description: Determines whether treasure enchantments are allowed on this item. Defaults to false.

destination.description: A tag of structure to locate. Defaults to on_treasure_maps.

decoration.description: The icon used to mark the destination on the map. Accepts any of the [[Map#Map icons|map icon text IDs]] (case insensitive). If mansion or monument is used, the color of the lines on the item texture changes to match the corresponding explorer map. Defaults to mansion.

zoom.description: The zoom level of the resulting map. Defaults to 2.

search_radius.description: The size, in chunks, of the area to search for structures. The area checked is square, not circular. Radius 0 causes only the current chunk to be searched, radius 1 causes the current chunk and eight adjacent chunks to be searched, and so on. Defaults to 50.

skip_existing_chunks.description: Don't search in chunks that have already been generated. Defaults to true.

entity.description: Specifies a player to be used for the player head. Specifies an entity from [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]]. Can be {{cd|this}}, {{cd|killer}}, {{cd|direct_killer}}, or {{cd|killer_player}}.

options.description: An integer to specify the exact limit to use.
Limits the count between a minimum and maximum value.

min.description: Optional. A [[Loot_table#Number_Providers|number provider]]. Minimum limit to use.

max.description: Optional. A [[Loot_table#Number_Providers|number provider]]. Maximum limit to use.

limit.description: Specifies the maximum amount of items in the stack after the looting calculation. If the value is 0, no limit is applied. Defaults to 0.

attribute.description: The [[resource location]] of the attribute this modifier is to act upon.

amount.description: A [[Loot_table#Number_Provider|number provider]]. Specifies the amount of the modifier.

id.description: Optional. [[UUID]] to assign the modifier, in hyphenated hexadecimal format. If none specified, a new random UUID is generated.

slot.description: Sets the slots the item must be in for the modifier to take effect. One of: mainhand, offhand, feet, legs, chest, head.

replace.description: Set to `true` to replace the existing item attributes with the attributes in  modifiers. If `false`, the lines are appended to the list of existing attributes. Defaults to `true`.

patterns.description: List of patterns to add or replace with.

color.description: The color for this pattern. One of white, orange, magenta, light_blue, yellow, lime, pink, gray, light_gray, cyan, purple, blue, brown, green, red, black.

append.description: Required. If true, the patterns will be applied on top of the banner's existing patterns.

author.description: Sets the author of the book. If omitted, the original author is kept (or an empty string is used if there was no component).

generation.description: Sets the generation value of the book (original, copy, etc.). Allowed values are `0` to `3`. If omitted, the original generation is kept (or `0` is used if there was no component).

title.description: Sets the title of the book as a raw JSON text component. If omitted, the original title is kept (or an empty string is used if there was no component).

components.description: A map of components ID to component value. Components with a `!` prefix (e.g. `"!minecraft:damage": {}`) causes this component to be removed.

entries.description: A list of [[Loot table|loot table entry producer]] to provide item stacks.

type.description: the block entity type to be written in BlockEntityTag.id.

add.description: Optional. If true, change will be relative to current count. Defaults to false.

tag.description: The NBT to merge onto the item's tag tag, within a JSON string. The outer braces { } of the NBT must be present within this JSON string. Additional care is required when the NBT contains quotation marks ", as they must be escaped from the JSON syntax with a backslash \.

add.description: Optional. If true, change will be relative to current damage. Defaults to false.

damage.description: A [[Loot_table#Number_Providers|number provider]]. Specifies the damage fraction to set (1.0 is undamaged, 0.0 is zero durability left).

enchantments.description: Enchantments to modify. Key name is the [[Java_Edition_data_value#Enchantments|enchantment ID]]. Value is a [[Loot_table#Number_Providers|number provider]] specifying the enchantment power. Powers are clamped at a maximum of 255. Decreasing an enchantment power below 1 will remove the enchantment, through a relative negative add or through a direct value assignemnt.

add.description: Optional. If true, change will be relative to current level. A nonexistent enchantment will be presumed to start at 0. Defaults to false.

mode.description: Determines how existing fireworks component should be modified.

offset.description: Specifies index to insert or replace explosions from. Defaults to `0`. Only applicable if property `mode` is `insert` or `replace_section`.

size.description: Specifies the size of the range to be replaced. If omitted, the size of the `values` field is used. Only applicable if property `mode` is `replace_section`.

flight_duration.description: Allowed values are `0` to `255`. Determines flight duration measured in number of gunpowder. If omitted, the flight duration of the item is left untouched (or set to `0` if the component did not exist before).

options.description: The resource location started with # of an instrument [[tag]], one of the listings is selected randomly.

name.description: Specifies the [[resource location]] of the loot table to be used.

type.description: the block entity type to be written in BlockEntityTag.id.

seed.description: Optional. Specifies the loot table seed. If absent or set to 0, the seed won't be put into the NBT, and a random seed will be used when opening the continer.

lore.description: List of lines to append or replace on the item's lore. Components requiring [[Raw_JSON_text_format#Component_resolution|resolution]] are resolved only if entity successfully targets an entity.

entity.description: Specifies the entity to act as @s when referenced in the JSON text component. Specifies an entity from [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]]. Can be {{cd|this}}, {{cd|killer}}, {{cd|direct_killer}}, or {{cd|killer_player}}.

replace.description: Optional. Set to true to replace the existing item lore with only the lines in {{nbt|list|lore}}. If false, the lines are appended to the list of existing lines of lore. Defaults to false.

mode.description: Determines how existing lore component should be modified.

offset.description: Specifies index to insert or replace lines of lore from. Defaults to `0`. Only applicable if property `mode` is `insert` or `replace_section`.

size.description: Specifies the size of the range to be replaced. If omitted, the size of the `lore` field is used. Only applicable if property `mode` is `replace_section`.

entity.description: Specifies the entity to act as @s when referenced in the JSON text component. Specifies an entity from [[Loot table#Loot context types|loot context]]. Can be {{cd|this}}, {{cd|killer}}, {{cd|direct_killer}}, or {{cd|killer_player}}.

name.description: A [[Raw JSON text format|JSON text component]], overwriting the previous custom name on the item. Components requiring [[Raw_JSON_text_format#Component_resolution|resolution]] are resolved only if entity successfully targets an entity.

target.description: Allowed values are `custom_name` or `item_name`, corresponding with the component to be set. Defaults to `custom_name`.

id.description: The [[Potion#Java_Edition|potion ID]]. Set to empty to remove the Potion tag.

duration.description: A [[Loot_table#Number_Providers|number provider]]. The duration of the effect.

pages.description: A list of pages as raw JSON text components.

mode.description: Determines how existing lore component should be modified.

offset.description: Specifies index to insert or replace pages from. Defaults to `0`. Only applicable if property `mode` is `insert` or `replace_section`.

size.description: Specifies the size of the range to be replaced. If omitted, the size of the `pages` field is used. Only applicable if property `mode` is `replace_section`.
